page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:1 mapping of physical cores to vCPUs and one thread per core, this instance provides dedicated CPU allocation to ensure consistent compute performance without resource sharing.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This dense memory configuration is designed to support memory-intensive workloads. The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating rapid data transfer between the instance and other cloud resources.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.r7.16xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for enterprise applications requiring large memory footprints relative to compute resources. The absence of bundled local storage and GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, focusing the instance's value proposition entirely on memory capacity and dedicated CPU execution. This makes it highly suitable for large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-heavy data processing pipelines.
